title: Canada: every game is a try-out (plan, nothing built yet)
kaylee: In every Canada game her own finger finds out what that friend can do for the team, and something from her play goes to the big game. Same games, same controls.
questions: Red Canoe: is Lulu's chick lost (a little sad, a big hug at the end) or playing hide-and-seek (all giggles)?
Whales: Ollie's lucky rock becomes the team's puck, and she shoots it in the big game. Yes or no?
Bike: at the bottom Monty stands in the trail and she can't steer past him (a soft bonk, a giggle). Add it, or leave the bike alone?

pictures.title: 🐋 Whales: the rock goes whale to whale
pictures.caption: Now Ollie is towed while whales do tricks. Plan: "A team needs a puck!" Her rock is always in sight: off the grey whale's back, thrown by the humpback's jump, on the baby's nose, then Ollie spin-passes it to Maple.

pictures.title: 🛶 Red Canoe: bring Lulu's chick home
pictures.caption: Now it's two errands (milky water, then bubbles). Plan: Lulu can't sing till her chick is back. Find it by its squeak, carry it to her bubbles, then tap Lulu: she sings and the glacier echoes.

pictures.title: ⛄ Snowballs: Tuque's tummy
pictures.caption: When Tuque wakes, the snowballs she pushes at him boing off. Her other snowmen become the crowd at the big game.

pictures.title: 🚵 Bike: nothing gets past Monty
pictures.caption: "We need a goalie. Somebody big!" At the bottom she steers left, he's there; right, he's there.

pictures.title: ⛺ Campfire: Roxy takes the puck
pictures.caption: Already the model: sneaking is her talent. One change: Maple's puck sits on the marshmallow bag, and that's what she yoinks.

pictures.title: 🛁 Bath: the big swat
pictures.caption: Already ties in (her look goes to the game). The soap swat over the cedars becomes a sure beat: the biggest shot in Canada.

pictures.title: 🗺️ The map: what the team still needs
pictures.caption: Each heart pin shows a little picture (net, song, puck, stick). Back home, Maple says it: "Now we have a goalie!"
